Current Setup MEDITE’S current water distribution process flow diagram can be seen in Appendix 3. Water is drawn from the adjacent Anner River into the onsite settling ponds. These ponds serve both as site fire water and process water requirements. This water is then fed through a 7 cartridge 50-micron filter media. From the filter bank it passes through two parallel plate heat exchangers and then fed to various processes one of these being a water tank. From the water storage tank it is then pumped through a typical De-Alk and softener process and then feeds the existing Line 1 boilers and Line 2 energy plant.
